allocation_note: 2MiB from existing active-pool headroom. No new raw capture, no change to rolling2GB ceiling or existing393216-byte unallocated offline subpool. Reused sources/input artifacts are already funded.
question: Does received-frame best-queue OFI improve prediction of local midpoint movement remaining after a400ms delay over the specified five-feature baseline, and can the frozen forecast clear delayed conditional quote costs?
interpretation: Observed transitions between public book frames; not every underlying event, identified cancellation, causal economic effect, authenticated fill or closed paper portfolio. All six inputs already exploratory for other questions. Chronological fit/evaluation is a modeling safeguard, not untouched prospective validation. Larger sizes are in scope;100 is one diagnostic baseline. The provenance32768-byte output cap applies to the entire study, not each chunk.
pin_note: Keep all existing inventory_context_v1 pins on chunks1–3 and7–9 for this new study. Reuse unchanged inventory.check_inputs solely for exact sealed-input validation and45 source pins, no inventory analysis or parameter mutation.
output_contract: Six immutable gzip JSON row tables retain every original560-row calendar, causal start/end BBO receipt/source/generation provenance, all feature/label failures and six independent size/direction quote profiles. Each gzip is capped262144 bytes on disk. Model is plain JSON capped32768 bytes; summary is gzip JSON capped98304 bytes on disk. A peer may independently freeze a different cross-asset analysis using exact table/source/input hashes without duplicating raw extraction. Sharing does not authorize changing this study's models, inputs or accounting. Summary decoded JSON is additionally capped2097152 bytes before compression.

features.formula: For successive valid same-generation BBO states: e=I(new_bid>=old_bid)*new_bid_qty-I(new_bid<=old_bid)*old_bid_qty-I(new_ask<=old_ask)*new_ask_qty+I(new_ask>=old_ask)*old_ask_qty. Initial state/snapshots do not contribute inferred flow. Sum transitions received in(t-lookback,t].
features.normalization: D_start=(start_bid_qty+start_ask_qty)/2 from the last valid book received at/before t-lookback, with receipt AND source ages at that boundary<=250ms. OFI/D_start. End book is last causally available at t, same250ms clock limits. Both state prices/quantities are exact native Decimal values; all feature values finite.
features.augmented: Exactly baseline plus normalized OFI. Store OFI components for unchanged-price versus price-changing transitions and zero-flow/zero-OFI flags descriptively; no extra model arms. When all BBO prices stay unchanged, OFI equals the difference between the two normalized endpoint-state features exactly.
features.ordinary_flow: Signed exact ordinary base quantity divided by total ordinary base quantity for received trades in the same1s feature window. Zero observed flow is0 only after own trade channel has supplied a valid live print at/before the window's left boundary and no trade invalidation since. A stale print makes that feature window unusable; do not suppress otherwise valid future generations or interpret unknown coverage as zero. Genuine adapter invalidation resets trade-history coverage; preserve subsequent suppressed-frame counters.
features.control_limitations: The five baseline features control the exact unchanged-BBO telescoping identity only. They do not fully control endpoint BBO state, spread, depth, nonlinear state relationships or ordinary trade intensity. A positive OFI increment may proxy those omitted features and cannot identify independent path information or a causal mechanism. This is a cheap delayed predictive/economic falsifier; any positive result needs a separately frozen follow-up addressing these limitations.
features.continuity: Book feature window requires a valid same-generation predecessor at/before its left boundary, no invalidation/snapshot reset or >500ms adjacent-book gap, and valid nonfuture source ages<=250ms for feature transitions. Book invalidation resets book histories and quote obligations; trade-only invalidation resets trade feature history without erasing intact book price outcomes. No backfilled anchors. Group equal receipt timestamps: fire earlier calendar anchors before the group, equal-time anchors after its last event.

calendar: 28 anchors per asset/venue/chunk at start+30,50,...570seconds, all20cells retained. All28*20=560 rows per chunk regardless of feature failure. First anchor or a later failed slot cannot be replaced. Each profile is bounded by14.8s;20s spacing prevents same-market quote holding-interval overlap. Exclude before requesting any profile when its worst-case interval can reach/cross the next known hourly funding boundary; retain funding exclusion. No reserved economics are read.
label: At each feature-usable anchor, observe first book whose receipt and source are both>=t+400ms; require receipt<=due+2s and noncrossed native book whose source/receipt age is<=250ms; the2s lateness bound is a separate limit. The first eligible failure is final. From its receipt request the exit at+10s+400ms with the same first-eligible/bounded policy. Target y=10000*(exit_mid-entry_mid)/entry_mid. This is remaining movement over the delayed quote lifecycle, not a pure exactly10-second or contemporaneous label. Record movement consumed from decision to entry separately. Missing/censored labels remain null.
native_quote_profiles: For each100/1000/10000 native collateral-unit target fix q=floor_to_qty_step(N/(decision_ask*1.01)), common to the two hypothetical directions and unchanged at exit. Enforce positive native price/quantity grids, minimum quantity/notional, published max_quote and max_qty when provided; explicitly retain maximum_base_quantity_unknown. At decision and both delayed endpoints walk full displayed side for exact q with no invented liquidity, no later favorable-book retry and no partials silently treated as full. Decision and entry value must not exceed that size N. Each direction/size is an independent conditional quote profile; no hypothetical market impact, fill or portfolio claim.
costs: Subtract fees on actual entry and exit notionals using each capture market metadata. Subtract5% annual capital assumption on prefunded native targetN over actual entry-to-exit elapsed seconds/31536000; report gross,fees,capital,net separately. Costs1/2/5bp are extra stress only, not venue fees, applied to actual entry value. Native collateral unitsUSDC/USDG stay separate; no FX/peg assumption or leveraged ROI. No unobserved funding credited; crossing anchors excluded before outcomes.
model: Two separate per-asset/venue OLS models. Same complete-feature-and-midpoint-label fit rows from chunks1–3, at least40. Standardize each feature using fit-only mean and population SD; constant columns dropped. Intercept included. numpy.linalg.lstsq with fixed rcond1e-10; report design rank/condition. Rank-deficient nonconstant or condition>1e8 design remains unavailable, with no solver/model/penalty rescue. Fit both models, publish exact means/scales/coefficients/training row identities and modelSHA before decoding any evaluation raw records. No retraining, clipping, direction reversal, hyperparameter search or cell/size selection. Evaluate exact same frozen models on7–9.
decision_policy: For each model/size and feature-usable evaluation anchor, sign(predicted_y) fixes direction. At the decision book estimate gross favorable midpoint value=abs(predicted_y)*q*decision_mid/10000. Subtract exact immediate full-q buy/sell spread/depth difference, actual decision-notional fee estimate, and capitalN*0.05*14.8/31536000. Admit only if the resulting predicted cash score>0 and decision native constraints pass; zero forecast/cost failure is an explicit abstention. No evaluation outcome enters the selection. Request profile observations for both directions independent of admission so paired errors/abstentions and failures are reviewable. No-trade benchmark0; compare baseline and augmented on the identical calendar.
evaluation: Retain all20cells and60cell/size policies, per-chunk and pooled. Forecast MSE/MAE and mean signed remaining midpoint on identical paired complete labels; report fit/feature/label failures and unavailable predictions. For each policy retain admissions, all entry/exit statuses, complete conditional net/capital/fee cash, net bp and1/2/5bp stress; abstentions are zero policy contributions, admitted missing outcomes are unknown and make the all-calendar cash mean unknown. Report policy differences paired on the same original anchors, plus all missing outcomes. Quantities and profiles remain distinct alternatives, never summed across sizes/assets/venues.
advance_gate: A cell/size is an exploratory follow-up candidate only if both models are available, augmented forecast MSE is strictly lower than baseline in EACH of the three evaluation chunks, augmented policy has>=3 admitted complete profiles in EACH chunk, BOTH policies have no admitted unresolved outcome in EACH chunk, augmented mean net conditional cash after actual fees and capital before extra stress is>0 in EACH chunk and its all-calendar cash contribution exceeds baseline in EACH chunk. An unresolved admitted baseline outcome makes the paired all-calendar difference unknown and prevents advancement. Record all stress results; no hard5bp fee invented. This is minimum evidence to consider separately frozen prospective replication, not statistical power or profitability validation. Otherwise park this linear version or classify insufficient coverage. No endpoint/threshold/asset/size tuning follows the result.

sources.supports: OFI definition and contemporaneous price-impact relation; does not establish lagged profit.
Forecast evidence on granular Nasdaq books and effective horizon around two average price changes; direct transfer is unproven.
